title: ctfkit.spacelift/1
description: The compact metadata file ctfkit by compliance.tf writes to ctfkit.custom.spacelift.json in the run's working directory. Spacelift exposes it to a plan policy as input.third_party_metadata.custom.ctfkit, so it stays small on purpose: the verdict, the level counts and one line per finding.

watermark.description: The optional banner line --watermark sets: one line of printable text. Absent when no banner was set.

summary.description: Counts over findings, by level. A policy can deny on summary.error without walking the array.
